tenants.title: Tenants & Onboarding
tenants.search_placeholder: Search by customer slug, display name, or site...
tenants.empty_description: Create your first customer tenant to issue isolated bearer tokens, provision read-only Grafana portals, and generate 1-click Grafana Alloy onboarding scripts.
tenants.portal_info_title: Isolated Customer Grafana Portals & 1-Click MSP Support View
tenants.portal_info_desc: Each customer gets an isolated Grafana Organization enforced server-side via prom-label-proxy and Loki X-Scope-OrgID.
tenants.portal_step_1: Enable the portal & create customer accounts under "Customer Accounts" (Viewer or Editor).
tenants.portal_step_2: Customers sign in at the central Grafana Login URL and land directly on their isolated fleet dashboard.
tenants.portal_step_3: MSP support clicks "Customer View" to simulate the exact isolated customer portal (?orgId=<id>) using their own AD/Admin login.
tenants.one_time_token_warning: Copy and store this bearer token securely now. Only its SHA-256 hash is stored on the Hub—this plaintext secret will never be shown again.
tenants.customer_slug_helper: 3–48 lowercase alphanumeric characters with internal hyphens (e.g. acme-corp).
tenants.sites_helper: Comma-separated lowercase site slugs (e.g. hq, dc1, branch-berlin).
tenants.contact_emails_helper: Comma-separated email recipients used when per-customer email alert routing is enabled.
tenants.portal_section_desc: Creates a dedicated Grafana Organization isolated server-side via prom-label-proxy and Loki X-Scope-OrgID. Manage multiple Viewer/Editor accounts via 'Customer Accounts'.
tenants.portal_password_min_helper: Optional initial account (min. 10 characters when set; manage multiple accounts anytime under 'Customer Accounts').
tenants.portal_password_keep_helper: Leave empty to keep existing password, or enter at least 10 characters to change.
tenants.portal_disabled_warning_title: Customer Portal is currently disabled for this tenant
tenants.portal_disabled_warning_desc: Enable the Customer Grafana Portal to provision the isolated Grafana Organization and sync customer login accounts.
tenants.portal_no_accounts: No customer accounts configured yet. Use the form below to create the first login account.
tenants.portal_user_username_helper: 3–64 characters (a-z, A-Z, 0-9, ._-); globally unique across Grafana.
tenants.portal_user_password_edit_helper: Leave empty to keep current password, or enter at least 10 characters to reset.
tenants.portal_credentials_ready_title: Account {username} saved — Copy Customer Login Credentials
tenants.portal_credentials_ready_desc: Send this summary securely to the customer. Plaintext passwords cannot be viewed again later.
tenants.validation_portal_user_username: Enter a valid username (3–64 chars: a-z, A-Z, 0-9, ._-).
tenants.validation_portal_user_email: Enter a valid email address or leave empty.

tenants.saved_description: Tenant {customer} configuration and Grafana organization sync completed.
tenants.rotate_modal_desc: Issues a new high-entropy bearer token. Set a grace window so remote NS8 collectors and Alloy agents can be updated without dropping metrics or logs.
tenants.grace_period_minutes_helper: 0 revokes the previous token immediately; 60 keeps both tokens valid for 1 hour (max 10080).
tenants.validation_grace_minutes: Enter an integer between 0 and 10080 minutes.
tenants.delete_modal_desc: Deleting tenant {customer} revokes all ingest tokens immediately and removes its Customer Portal organization.
tenants.delete_central_targets_label: Also delete central pull/probe targets owned by this tenant
tenants.deleted_description: Tenant {customer} and its access credentials have been removed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.unconfigured_title: Central Monitoring Hub is not configured yet
settings.unconfigured_description: Set an FQDN hostname and TLS policy in Settings to publish the Grafana portal and HTTPS telemetry ingest endpoints.
settings.ingress_section_desc: Exposes Grafana UI and authenticated Prometheus/Loki ingest endpoints (/api/v1/write, /loki/api/v1/push) via NS8 Traefik.
settings.host_helper: Must resolve to this NethServer 8 node (e.g. monitoring.msp.example.com).
settings.storage_section_desc: Use local volumes for compact deployments or S3/MinIO with Thanos Sidecar/Store/Query for multi-month fleet retention.
settings.retention_days_helper: In S3 mode, controls local hot cache retention while Thanos queries historical blocks from S3.
settings.storage_mode_s3: S3 / MinIO Object Storage + Thanos Query
settings.s3_section_desc: Shared bucket for Loki TSDB v13 chunks/index and Thanos 2-hour Prometheus blocks.
settings.auth_section_title: MSP Technician SSO (NS8 LDAP / AD) & Grafana Admin
settings.auth_section_desc: Integrates NS8 user domains with Grafana Main Org (Org 1) while keeping Customer Portals strictly isolated.
settings.ldap_enabled_label: Enable NS8 LDAP / Active Directory Login for MSP Org 1
settings.ldap_discovered_summary: Directory loaded ({schema} — Base DN: {base_dn} — {groups} groups, {users} users found)
settings.ldap_discover_failed_title: Could not load directory groups and users automatically
settings.ldap_multiselect_placeholder: Search AD/LDAP groups or users, or type a DN...
settings.ldap_admin_group_label: Org-1-Admin (Groups & Users — Full MSP Admin Access)
settings.ldap_editor_group_helper: Assign one or more AD/LDAP groups and/or individual AD/LDAP users per role. Only assigned groups or users receive access to MSP Organization 1 (unmapped LDAP/AD accounts are denied access).
settings.ldap_test_section_desc: Verify directory lookup, nested AD group resolution, direct user assignment, and the resulting Grafana Org 1 role before signing in.
settings.ldap_test_validation_username: Enter an AD/LDAP username to test.
settings.ldap_test_unmapped_title: User found in directory, but no Org 1 role group matched (login denied)
settings.grafana_admin_password_helper: Leave empty to keep current password, or enter at least 8 characters to update.
settings.self_monitoring_section_desc: Harvests host metrics (/proc, filesystems, network) plus all local NS8 pods, containers, and Restic backups via Linux cgroups v2 without deploying a separate collector.
settings.monitor_local_ns8_node_label: Monitor this NS8 Hub node including all local NS8 pods (cgroups v2)
settings.local_node_customer_helper: Select '_msp_internal' to keep Hub host & pod metrics visible exclusively in MSP Main Org 1, or assign them to a customer tenant.
settings.local_node_site_helper: 2–48 lowercase alphanumeric characters with optional internal hyphens (default: hub).
settings.backup_section_desc: Configs, tenants, hashed tokens, targets, custom rules, silences, and an online SQLite dump of grafana.db are always backed up.
settings.backup_include_tsdb_label: Include Raw Prometheus & Loki TSDB Volumes in Restic Backup
settings.validation_host: Enter a valid FQDN hostname (e.g. monitoring.msp.example.com).
settings.validation_retention_days: Enter a retention period between 1 and 3650 days.
settings.validation_retention_size_gb: Enter a disk cap between 0 and 100000 GiB.
settings.validation_s3_endpoint: Enter host[:port] without scheme or path slashes.
settings.validation_s3_bucket: Enter a valid lowercase S3 bucket name (3–63 chars).
settings.validation_s3_access_key: S3 Access Key ID is required when S3 mode is enabled.

settings.validation_ldap_domain: Select or enter an NS8 LDAP/AD user domain.
settings.validation_grafana_password: Grafana admin password must be at least 8 characters.
settings.validation_local_node_customer: Select '_msp_internal' or enter a valid lowercase customer slug (3–48 chars).
settings.validation_local_node_site: Enter a valid lowercase site slug (2–48 alphanumeric/hyphen chars, e.g. hub).
